_comment: Recraft raster logo prompt templates. Variables: {brand}, {subject}, {colors}, {bg}, {shape_block}, {no_text}.

default_colors.fantasy: emerald green, antique gold, deep crimson
default_colors.future: neon cyan, electric purple, deep black
default_colors.greetingcard: soft rose, sage green, lavender, ivory

shape_block: Hard shape constraint: the entire logo is fully enclosed inside a perfect {SHAPE} container. Nothing extends outside the {Shape}.

no_text.icon_only: No text, no letters, no words, no numbers anywhere in the image.
no_text.with_brand: The ONLY text allowed is exactly "{brand}" with correct spelling.
